svg.title: Pass the Phone Discovery Handoff Visual Design Suite (Era 3)
svg.desc: Complete Era 3 Family Cookbook visual design specification for pass-the-phone-discovery-handoff: per-device Settings switch with collapsed/expanded How it works flyout, parent wrap-up with reused scrollable MemberPickerList, full-screen handoff curtain with switching and Hearth error recovery, kid locked clean voting screen with Handoff Dock and exit confirmation, kid wrap-up with multi-kid passing, converged return with Garden closure toast, French 320px reflow, and High Contrast AAA.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Pass the Phone Discovery Handoff
Settings Opt-In · Handoff Dock · Zero Dead Ends
Pass the Phone — Visual Design & Locked Kid Turn Suite
Per-device Settings toggle with inline flyout, 100% clean voting cards, reused scrollable chooser, locked Handoff Dock, and calm welcome-back closure.
1. /profile/settings — Compact Per-Device Opt-In (Below Manage Family) & "How it works" Flyout

g.text: State A · Compact Card (Default OFF / ON)
Add kids or household members above
“Add another family member above to use this.”
State B · "How it works" Flyout Expanded
Let the kids help pick supper
After you finish voting, pass your phone
along — the rest of the app stays tucked
away until they hand it back.
Only turns on for this device.

svg.text: 2. Parent Wrap-Up (“That’s a wrap!”) + Reused Scrollable Member Dropdown + Full-Screen Handoff Curtain

g.text: Scrolls cleanly for large families · No status cues
fixed inset-0 z-[70] · hides cards & nav dock
Cancel returns to Alex’s screen unchanged.
Holds until Alex’s pendingVotesRef is empty,
clears stack & matchCount, then switches member.
Curtain stays closed — no queue revealed.
Couldn’t switch to Maya just now.

svg.text: 3. Locked Kid Turn (4–12) — Clean Voting Screen, Quiet Handoff Dock, Celebration Wrap-Up & Calm Return

g.text: 3A · Clean Voting Screen + Quiet Handoff Dock
Zero extra controls on the voting screen
Pure celebration · Dock exits directly once finished
Mid-Stack Dock Exit: Return to Alex?
Maya’s votes so far are saved.
• Pass to next sibling from Alex’s wrap-up if needed
✓ Min 12px type floor · Outfit + Inter only
✓ Deleted origin or offline switch recovers safely
